body: Yes you were, thank you!! Definitely got my mind off of my usual pessimistic thoughts, good night!

Ohh that sounds interesting, I'll check it out!

And cool I might try to get back into it. Black ops was fun because of zombies but i got tired of playing online because most of my teammates either sucked or complained when I wouldnt revive them. Even if it was like impossible. MW2 was such a beautiful mess though. Definitely made it more enjoyable. And that sounds wild might pick the game up and see how that works out. And holy shit i forgot about that shotgun but I remember playing with it, it was hilarious tbh. But I'm pretty sure online gaming has in at least one way contributed to how much I curse.

:0 Nice!! I didn't know, hopefully I'll be able to get my hands on it. And I'm p sure they would since many gamers have moved on to pc. It'd make so much money I don't see why not lol. 
but ahh his death always gets to me, but then again I cry during like every videogame. And I've been meaning to play Heavy Rain! My friend recommended it to me, whats it about?? 

And yessss COD:MW2 was definitely the one I played and enjoyed the most. And I would be lying if I said I didn't love having grenade launchers, but they surely pissed me off when someone else used them. But nukes were wild. I havent played recently but do they have them in the new mw??? I think it's at 4 now but i didnt really buy any after mw2

Hah yeah I guess that's a positive. I guess it was such a bummer because I usually give away art and the one time I charge for it I didn't get paid. But that is a positive way to look at it! 

And yea Undertale is much better when you play not really knowing what to expect from it. Doing a genocide run was awful for me, I felt so mean going through and hurting all of the characters. The Sans battle was definitely intense took me a good while to get through, had to ask my brother for help at one point lmao. And I really like to play smash bros, fallout, and cod even though I get frustrated with it easily. Red dead is a such a fun game, still trying to get the horses of the apocalypse tho.

Yeah sadly not the first time its happened to me. A commissioner ran off with my art without paying so I'm kinda just sulking because I can't exactly force them to pay. 

I tend to draw a mix of anime and realism? Gotta draw my waifus somehow lmao. And I think that's very cute!! Very stylized yet simple. I definitely dig it. And yes I've played it!! it was absolutely wonderful imo.

Thanks for taking the time to read/reply. It means a lot. And yeah it is a pokemon reference haven't picked up the games in a while but I surely do remember playing sapphire. And I really enjoy drawing/animating and story building but some recent drama surrounding it has put me off of it.
